  • 판토텐산

drafts.en:
Health Functional FoodVitamin B1 2.4mgVitamin B12 4.8μgVitamin B2 2.8mgVitamin B6 3mgZinc 8.5mgFolate 800μgPantothenic acid 10mgOnce a day

활력충전 비타민B 컴플렉스 면역 츄어블Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by 코스맥스엔비티(주) · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 2.4mg of Vitamin B1, 4.8μg of Vitamin B12, 2.8mg of Vitamin B2, 3mg of Vitamin B6, 8.5mg of Zinc, 800μg of Folate, 10mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 2.4mg Vitamin B1, 4.8μg Vitamin B12, 2.8mg Vitamin B2, 3mg Vitamin B6, 8.5mg Zinc, 800μg Folate, 10mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 코스맥스엔비티(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingChew to take

Labelled standard

Vitamin B1 labelled (2.4mg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (4.8μg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (2.8mg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (3mg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (8.5mg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (800μg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (10mg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미 이취가 없으며 점박이가 있는 탁한 노란주황색 원형 츄어블 정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 1) 직사광선이나 고온 다습한 곳을 피하여 청결하고 서늘한 곳에 보관하십시오. 2) 제품 개봉 후에는 흡습이 일어날 수 있으니 반드시 밀봉하여 보관 하십시오.3) 영유아 및 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
